mapper.insert: INSERT INTO APPROVAL (APPROVAL_NO, USER_NO, APPROVAL_TYPE, APPROVAL_STATUS, APPROVAL_TITLE, APPROVAL_CONTENT, START_DATE, APPROVAL_USER) VALUES (APPROVAL_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{userNo}, #{approvalType}, 1, #{approvalTitle}, #{approvalContent}, SYSDATE, #{approvalUser})
mapper.select: SELECT APPROVAL_NO as approvalNo, USER_NO as userNo, APPROVAL_TYPE as approvalType, APPROVAL_STATUS as approvalStatus, APPROVAL_TITLE as approvalTitle, APPROVAL_CONTENT as approvalContent, START_DATE as startDate, END_DATE as endDate, APPROVAL_USER as approvalUser, CREATED_AT as createdAt FROM APPROVAL ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT POSITION_NAME, DEPT_NAME, USER_NAME, USER_NO FROM MEMBER JOIN DEPARTMENT USING(DEPT_NO) JOIN POSITION USING(POSITION_NO) ORDER BY DEPT_NAME, USER_NAME

SELECT APPROVAL_NO as approvalNo, USER_NO as userNo, APPROVAL_TYPE as approvalType, APPROVAL_STATUS as approvalStatus, APPROVAL_TITLE as approvalTitle, APPROVAL_CONTENT as approvalContent, START_DATE as startDate, END_DATE as endDate, APPROVAL_USER as approvalUser FROM APPROVAL WHERE APPROVAL_STATUS = 4 ORDER BY START_DATE DESC

mapper.select: SELECT USER_NO, APPROVAL_NO, APPROVAL_TYPE, APPROVAL_STATUS, APPROVAL_TITLE, APPROVAL_CONTENT, START_DATE, APPROVAL_USER FROM APPROVAL WHERE APPROVAL_NO = #{approvalNo}

SELECT A.APPROVAL_LEVEL, A.APPROVAL_NO, A.USER_NO, A.TYPE, A.STATUS, A.CONFIRM_STATUS, A.APPROVAL_DATE, A.APPROVAL_LINE_TYPE, M.USER_NAME AS userName, D.DEPT_NAME AS deptName, P.POSITION_NAME AS positionName FROM APPROVAL_LINE A JOIN MEMBER M ON A.USER_NO = M.USER_NO JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON M.DEPT_NO = D.DEPT_NO JOIN POSITION P ON M.POSITION_NO = P.POSITION_NO WHERE A.APPROVAL_NO = #{approvalNo} ORDER BY A.APPROVAL_LEVEL
SELECT FILE_NO, APPROVAL_NO, REF_NO, ORIGIN_NAME, FILE_DATA FROM APPROVAL_ATTACHMENT WHERE APPROVAL_NO = #{approvalNo}

SELECT D.DEPT_NAME, P.POSITION_NAME, M.USER_NAME, A.USER_NO, A.MEMO_NO, A.MEMO_CONTENT, A.MEMO_DATE FROM APPROVAL_MEMO A JOIN MEMBER M ON A.USER_NO = M.USER_NO JOIN DEPARTMENT D ON M.DEPT_NO = D.DEPT_NO JOIN POSITION P ON M.POSITION_NO = P.POSITION_NO WHERE A.APPROVAL_NO = #{approvalNo}
SELECT USER_NAME FROM APPROVAL A JOIN MEMBER M ON A.USER_NO = M.USER_NO WHERE A.APPROVAL_NO = #{approvalNo}

SELECT M.USER_NAME, A.APPROVAL_NO, A.USER_NO, A.APPROVAL_TYPE, A.APPROVAL_STATUS, L.STATUS, A.APPROVAL_TITLE, A.START_DATE, A.END_DATE FROM APPROVAL A JOIN MEMBER M ON A.USER_NO = M.USER_NO JOIN APPROVAL_LINE L ON A.APPROVAL_NO = L.APPROVAL_NO WHERE L.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND L.TYPE = '결재자' ORDER BY A.START_DATE DESC

SELECT M.USER_NAME, A.APPROVAL_NO, A.USER_NO, A.APPROVAL_TYPE, A.APPROVAL_STATUS, A.APPROVAL_TITLE, A.START_DATE, MAX(A.END_DATE) AS END_DATE FROM APPROVAL A JOIN MEMBER M ON A.USER_NO = M.USER_NO JOIN APPROVAL_LINE L ON A.APPROVAL_NO = L.APPROVAL_NO WHERE A.USER_NO = #{userNo} GROUP BY M.USER_NAME, A.APPROVAL_NO, A.USER_NO, A.APPROVAL_TYPE, A.APPROVAL_STATUS, A.APPROVAL_TITLE, A.START_DATE ORDER BY A.START_DATE DESC

SELECT M.USER_NAME, A.APPROVAL_NO, A.USER_NO, A.APPROVAL_TYPE, A.APPROVAL_STATUS, L.STATUS, A.APPROVAL_TITLE, A.START_DATE, A.END_DATE FROM APPROVAL A JOIN MEMBER M ON A.USER_NO = M.USER_NO JOIN APPROVAL_LINE L ON A.APPROVAL_NO = L.APPROVAL_NO WHERE L.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND L.TYPE = '참조자' ORDER BY A.START_DATE DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APPROVAL A JOIN MEMBER M ON A.USER_NO = M.USER_NO JOIN APPROVAL_LINE L ON A.APPROVAL_NO = L.APPROVAL_NO WHERE L.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND L.TYPE = '결재자' ORDER BY A.START_DATE DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APPROVAL A JOIN MEMBER M ON A.USER_NO = M.USER_NO JOIN APPROVAL_LINE L ON A.APPROVAL_NO = L.APPROVAL_NO WHERE L.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND L.TYPE = '참조자' ORDER BY A.START_DATE DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APPROVAL A JOIN MEMBER M ON A.USER_NO = M.USER_NO JOIN APPROVAL_LINE L ON A.APPROVAL_NO = L.APPROVAL_NO WHERE L.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND L.APPROVAL_LINE_TYPE = '수신' ORDER BY A.START_DATE DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APPROVAL WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo} AND APPROVAL_STATUS = 3

SELECT a.approval_no, a.user_no, a.approval_type, a.approval_status, a.approval_title, a.approval_content, a.start_date, a.end_date, m.user_name AS userName FROM APPROVAL a JOIN MEMBER m ON a.user_no = m.user_no WHERE a.user_no = #{userNo} AND a.approval_status = 1
